perf.title: Host performance
perf.intro: Whole-machine CPU / Memory / Disk I/O / Network sampled every {{interval}} by the kanade-agent's host_perf loop. Older agents (< 0.40) don't publish this — the chart will be empty for those until they upgrade.
perf.empty: No samples in this range yet.

process.title: Process detail
process.intro: Off by default — walking the full process table is the most expensive sysinfo call we make, so opt in per-PC only while you're investigating. Auto-disables when the timer below expires; the agent stops publishing samples without you having to come back and clear the flag.
process.emptyOff: Enable process detail above to start collecting samples.
process.emptyOn: Waiting for the first sample — should arrive within one cadence tick (~60 s by default).
